prompt:
Production Unity sprite animation sheet for Swarmer. Reference defines exact enemy identity, silhouette and perspective. Create redrawn articulated action frames of this same creature. Matte dark rock-brown armor, pale gray-white sinew, subtle amber slit eyes, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D style. Fixed elevated 45deg game view, soft upper-left lighting. Very low, flat, small quadruped scout with one broad smooth wedge-shaped brown rocky carapace covering its back, small pointed front head with a narrow amber eye slit, pale gray tendon limbs splayed laterally, FOUR limbs only. No dorsal organs, no horns, no tall ridges. Keep the low turtle/beetle silhouette of the reference.
EVERY frame faces: LEFT profile facing screen left, nose at left edge of body and tail at right; keep this direction in EVERY pose. No camera or body angle changes during abilities/death. 
Grid EXACTLY FOUR columns and 4 rows; 16 complete separate bodies. Square canvas width-to-height 4:4. Each creature fits middle 60% of its cell; generous transparent gutters so no neighboring toes/armor touch. Same body scale and ground anchor throughout. Rows1-2: EIGHT distinct sequential WALK frames, alternating diagonal foot pairs lift and plant with a continuous scuttling gait, torso stays nearly level. Row3: FOUR distinct IDLE breathing poses, planted feet, subtle living tissues, no whole-body scaling. Row4: FOUR distinct DEATH poses: legs progressively buckle, carapace settles onto floor, head rests, eye goes dark; a quiet non-explosive collapse.
Draw genuine distinct joint motion; do not copy identical stills or merely rotate/scale. Maintain anatomy and plate layout. Full transparent alpha0 background, including between legs. No opaque brown backdrop, no ground/shadow, text, labels, grid, particles or projectiles.
